topic: SP-061 security lows: state folder and content hashes
detail: From the PR security review, low: the Slack connector's watermark file is written mode 0600, but the folder it is in is created 0700 only when missing; an existing folder others can write would let them replace the file (watermarks only, no content). The file holds plain SHA-256 hashes of each record's text, so someone able to read it could confirm a guessed short message. Options: check the folder is the user's alone when the scheduler (RC-1650) picks it (inside orch's data dir), and key the hashes with a per-install secret (HMAC).
